run_synthetic_traffic_generator: run the adaptive router traffic simulator with --proxy-url, --api-key, --router, --rounds, and --rate flags
build_messages_conversation: build a 5-message conversation list that passes the signal gate minimum messages threshold
send_chat_completion_request: send a mock chat completion request to the LiteLLM proxy and read the chosen model header
drive_one_labeled_session: drive one labeled session that sends two rounds of requests to learn and credit model picks
configure_oracle_success_probabilities: configure the oracle dictionary to set success probabilities per request type and model pair
